title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
statement_short: Implement a Trie with insert(word), search(word), and startsWith(prefix) methods. search returns true if word is in the trie, and startsWith returns true if there is a previously inserted word with the given prefix.
constraints: 1 <= word.length, prefix.length <= 2000, word and prefix consist of lowercase English letters, at most 3 \* 10^4 calls
hint: Efficient string prefix matching and retrieval mandates a tree data structure where nodes represent individual characters.
keywords: previously inserted word with the given prefix
why_not: Right: Trie stores characters at child nodes, enabling O(L) time insertion, word search, and prefix matching. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Hash sets support O(L) exact word lookup, but cannot perform O(L) prefix matching without checking all stored keys. Not Binary Search: Binary search on a sorted string array checks prefixes in O(L log N) time, which is slower than linear Trie traversal. Not Tree DFS: General binary trees do not organize character edges for multi-child prefix branches.
complexity: O(L) time per operation, O(N \* L) space
